archive.notes: Deterministic archive produced by `python framework/BaronyModLoader/app/barony_mod_loader.py package pack mods/stash --out framework/BaronyModLoader/fixtures/Stash-0.1.0.bmlpkg`.

runtime.notes: The v1 runtime path is the BML-owned installed-binary hook/bootstrap contract. Stash remains fail-closed because the required behavior-changing gameplay detour set is not installed yet.

hookLibrary.notes: The hook library can load, report, pass the fake-symbol absolute-jump detour self-test, classify decoder-safe Stash target prologues, install opt-in pass-through detours for Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer, the seven-target core inventory lifecycle set via BML_STASH_INSTALL_CORE_PASSTHROUGH=1, and the six-target access/placement set via BML_STASH_INSTALL_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_PASSTHROUGH=1, prove fake-provider call-through for all six access/placement replacements via BML_STASH_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_SELF_TEST=1, rewrite the access/placement install report at process exit with live stock-game replacement call counts, relocate backward relative branches such as the installed Entity::addItemToChest thunk into an absolute jump to the out-of-line body, skip inherited LD_PRELOAD inside non-Barony helper processes unless BML_HOOK_ALLOW_NON_BARONY=1 is set, run the fake-provider-only experimental state-backed core lifecycle self-test via BML_STASH_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_CORE_BEHAVIOR=1 plus BML_STASH_CORE_BEHAVIOR_SELF_TEST=1 including generic chest add/get mutation, pass a timed installed Steam/Linux behavior-detour plus access/placement install probe without claiming Stash loaded, and still fail closed because the behavior-changing in-game Stash gameplay hook set is incomplete.

hookManifest.notes: Pins Steam app/build, Linux platform, game version, executable hash/build id, symbol probes, and fail-closed Stash hook targets.

runtimeInfo.notes: Fixture declares installed-binary-hook policy and rejects partial Stash loads.

runtimeProvenance.notes: Release provenance is now the installed Steam/Linux executable plus BML hook artifacts, not a patched Barony source build.

compatibility.notes: The current release target is Steam/Linux app 371970 build 22630456. Playable Stash compatibility is still pending function detours and in-game verification.

patches.notes: Historical source patch retained as design reference; it is not the primary v1 runtime provenance path.
Historical source-level Stash hook reference; gameplay release support must come through installed-executable hook targets.

patchSeries.notes: Patch files remain checksummed semantic/source references only. The primary v1 release provenance is runtimeProvenance.installed-binary-hook.

buildArtifacts.notes: No patched/source-built Barony executable is claimed for this v1 release manifest. The installed Steam executable identity is recorded under runtimeProvenance.installedExecutable.

artifactVerification.notes: Release artifact provenance is present for the installed Steam/Linux hook path.

reports.notes: Runtime load reporting is the canonical hook-load report path for profiles.
Symbol probing can identify required Steam/Linux symbols without claiming gameplay hooks are installed.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_DETOUR_SELF_TEST=1 and validates the fake-symbol absolute-jump detour, near-target trampoline allocation, relocated RIP-relative cmp displacement, relocated short conditional branch prologue, and trampoline call-through.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_DETOUR_SELF_TEST=1 and validates an opt-in fake-symbol Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer detour plus trampoline call-through without claiming in-game Stash behavior.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_INSTALL_ADD_ITEM_PASSTHROUGH=1 and validates an opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour install for Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer while runtime-load-report still contains BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED for the incomplete Stash hook set.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_INSTALL_CORE_PASSTHROUGH=1 and validates opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour installs for Entity::getChestInventoryList, Entity::addItemToChest, Entity::getItemFromChest, Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer, Entity::removeItemFromVoidChestServer, Entity::closeChest, and Entity::closeChestServer while runtime-load-report still contains BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED for the incomplete Stash hook set.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_INSTALL_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_PASSTHROUGH=1 and BML_STASH_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_SELF_TEST=1, validates opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour installs for actChest, actChestLid, generateDungeon, assignActions, newEntity, and setSpriteAttributes, and proves fake-provider call-through by rewriting replacementCalls before the report is checked while runtime-load-report still contains BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED for the incomplete Stash hook set. A timed installed Steam/Linux probe with BML_STASH_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_CORE_BEHAVIOR=1, BML_STASH_INSTALL_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_PASSTHROUGH=1, and no fake self-test also writes this report with all six access/placement target detours installed, rewrites it at process exit with live replacement calls for assignActions, newEntity, and setSpriteAttributes, and leaves runtime-load-report failed only with BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_SELF_TEST=1 under the fake provider and validates trampoline call-through for actChest, actChestLid, generateDungeon, assignActions, newEntity, and setSpriteAttributes, including generateDungeonResult=7 and at least one replacement call for every installed access/placement target. This remains a fake-provider call-through proof, not a stock-game placement or playable Stash behavior claim.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_CORE_BEHAVIOR=1 and BML_STASH_CORE_BEHAVIOR_SELF_TEST=1 under the fake provider, validates state-backed load/add/remove/save over stats[0]->void_chest_inventory via BaronyModLoader/state/stash-inventory-v1.tsv, exercises generic Entity::addItemToChest and Entity::getItemFromChest mutation against the same bound list, and still leaves runtime-load-report failed with BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED for the incomplete in-game Stash hook set. A timed installed Steam/Linux probe with BML_STASH_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_CORE_BEHAVIOR=1, BML_STASH_INSTALL_ACCESS_PLACEMENT_PASSTHROUGH=1, and no fake self-test also writes this report with all seven core inventory lifecycle target detours installed plus the access/placement install report with all six target detours installed, while runtime-load-report remains failed only with BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED.

Required Stash targets currently report not_installed with a conservative static/readiness split (34 ready, 0 blocked, 0 missing for Steam/Linux build 22630456) and failClosed=true until the behavior-changing hook set is implemented.

installedHookVerification.notes: Current status is intentionally non-playable: Stash activation must fail closed with BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED or equivalent target-level detour-unavailable codes.

rollback.notes: Rollback means disabling the jml.stash package and launching the installed Barony executable without the BML hook/bootstrap environment.
steps: Disable jml.stash in the profile package state before launch.
Launch the installed Steam Barony executable without LD_PRELOAD or BML hook environment variables.
Preserve BaronyModLoader profile state, hook reports, and stash inventory files for inspection; do not delete user data unless explicitly requested.
Regenerate launch/runtime manifests after the package is disabled so stale capability metadata and hook provenance are not reused.
rollback.risk: Existing experimental stash state may be unreadable by vanilla Barony or later hook revisions; preserve it separately rather than silently converting or deleting it.
